evidence.snippet: Measurement Time Register → This is for registration of measurement time. Initial Value is '0100_0101'.

candidate_bitfields.name: MT[4:0]

evidence.snippet: Power On | 0000_0001 | Waiting for measurement command.

steps.details: Send Reset command (0x07) after Power On

evidence.snippet: Reset | 0000_0111 | Reset Data register value. Reset command is not acceptable in Power Down mode.

steps.details: Wait max 180ms for first measurement completion

evidence.snippet: After about 240ms, measurement result is registered to Data Register. ( High Resolution mode is typically 120ms, but measurement time is set twice. )

steps.details: Read 2 bytes (High Byte then Low Byte) with I2C read

evidence.snippet: Read measurement result. ST | Slave Address | R/W 1 | Ack | High Byte [15:8] | Ack | Low Byte [7:0] | Ack | SP

steps.details: Send One Time H-Resolution Mode2 command (0x21)
Read 2 bytes (High Byte then Low Byte)

evidence.snippet: How to calculate when the data High Byte is '10000011' and Low Byte is '10010000' (2^15 + 2^9 + 2^8 + 2^7 + 2^4) / 1.2 ≒ 28067 [lx]
H-reslution mode : Illuminance per 1 count ( lx / count ) = 1 / 1.2 *( 69 / X )
H-reslution mode2 : Illuminance per 1 count ( lx / count ) = 1 / 1.2 *( 69 / X ) / 2

evidence_spans.snippet: Slave Address is 2 types, it is determined by ADDR Terminal ADDR = 'H' (ADDR ≧ 0.7VCC) → '1011100' ADDR = 'L' (ADDR ≦ 0.3VCC) → '0100011'

Instruction Set Architecture: Power Down 0000_0000, Power On 0000_0001, Reset 0000_0111, Continuously H-Resolution Mode 0001_0000, Continuously H-Resolution Mode2 0001_0001, Continuously L-Resolution Mode 0001_0011, One Time H-Resolution Mode 0010_0000, One Time H-Resolution Mode2 0010_0001, One Time L-Resolution Mode 0010_0011, Change Measurement time (High bit) 01000_MT[7,6,5], Change Measurement time (Low bit) 011_MT[4,3,2,1,0]

Data Register → This is for registration of Ambient Light Data. Initial Value is '0000_0000_0000_0000'. Measurement Time Register → This is for registration of measurement time. Initial Value is '0100_0101'.
H-reslution mode : Illuminance per 1 count ( lx / count ) = 1 / 1.2 *( 69 / X )
H-Resolution Mode Measurement Time | t HR | － | 120 | 180 | ms
DVI is I2C bus reference voltage terminal. And it is also asynchronous reset terminal. It is necessary to set to 'L' after VCC is supplied. In DVI 'L' term, internal state is set to Power Down mode.

requires_human: DVI is likely a typo for VCC in some contexts; confirm power supply sequence.
ADDR terminal has 3-state buffer; ensure proper pull-up/pull-down during power-up.
Measurement time may be doubled in some modes; verify actual timing.
